talking_points: Nvidia is reportedly closing in on a $500m+ deal for diffusion-AI startup Inception, scooping up researchers rather than just technology.
Congress released data showing US regulators approved only one in four requests to sell advanced AI chips to China, reigniting the Jensen Huang scandal fallout.
SpaceX borrowed $32bn at yields above 8% to fund AI chip purchases, a reminder that the AI boom is increasingly being financed with expensive debt.
